label: Unblocked preventable events would be strictly better prevented
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. OPEN outcome bridge: when a preventable event has no blocking cost in Rowe's sense (no unavoidable greater-good loss or equal/worse evil), preventing it is strictly better overall than permitting it. It fails if several individually lesser costs can jointly outweigh the suffering.
